source: voicesig build 2026-10-04: src/voicesig/**, server/voicesig/**, evals/voicesig/**, scripts/voicesig/k1-train.mjs, models/voicesig/filler-gru.*, docs/design/voice-signals/{INTEGRATION.md,migration-proposal.sql}; write-ups appended to context/decisions.md, measurements.md, rejected.md under 'voicesig build (2026-10-04)'

nodes.title: Filler detector (bi-GRU 32, 10,817 params, 45 KB fp32) on the product front-end's 22-dim relative features, AMI CC BY 4.0, speaker-disjoint (train 48 spk 10.3 h / val 12 / test 32 spk 7.2 h = all Indian-L1 series). Test word AUROC 0.942 [0.929, 0.955] vs shipped flat-run proxy 0.561 [0.526, 0.594]; event P/R 0.753/0.601 vs proxy 0.278/0.166; ECE 0.0073 calibrated. Indian-L1 adults 0.922 [0.907, 0.936]. ICSI cross-corpus 0.956 (block clusters, optimistic), P/R 0.696/0.626. FLEURS read-speech runs/speech-min hi 3.80 vs en 3.36. Not covered: children, Hindi fillers, phone AGC capture.
Filler ONNX p50 1 thread: node 0.31/0.92/1.76 ms, WASM 0.57/1.49/2.99 ms for 5/15/30 s turns (N=50, shared Xeon). int8 dynamic larger (47,092 B) and rejected; fp32 ships. Phone x2-4 [E].
CPU per audio-s (process.cpuUsage, 60 s): FrameCore 6.5 ms; 10 ms log-mel 9.85 ms with mixed-radix FFT (22.9 ms direct DFT); 20 ms mel 4.8 ms. Adapter toSignalInput p50 0.006 / p99 0.029 ms (n=20k).
Streaming log-mel ring vs HF WhisperFeatureExtractor(chunk_length=8) on one 8 s clip: interior max abs diff 1.7e-6 (mean 4.6e-8).
SY-1/SY-2 clean synthetic (n=21 turns, gaps 0.3-6 s, gains x0.25/x1/x4): onset error -10 ms constant; pauseFrac gain-invariant. Noise/child not covered.

SIMULATED pilot power through the product adapter + harness (20 reps, B=200): 95% half-width of dAUROC 0.042 at 30 children, 0.012 at 200; null median -0.001; effect x1 median 0.086 (pass 19/20 at 30); effect x0.5 median 0.010 at 30, 0.033 at 200 (pass 12/20). Null false-pass of the 80%-CI L2 bar 10/60 = 16.7% at 30 children.

nodes.title: PROPOSED: ladder L2 needs dAUROC >= 0.03 with the 95% child-clustered CI excluding 0 on >= 200 children.
Training h1-h4 on public corpora: none carries O1-O4 outcomes; IndicVoices/Vaani are gated; proxy labels would break the outcome-only label test.
Direct 400-pt DFT log-mel cost 22.9 ms CPU/audio-s (> 20 ms budget); replaced by mixed-radix FFT 9.85 ms.
Whole-channel AMI extraction at load 15-23 projected ~4 h; replaced by owner-speech regions +-2 s.
Simulator effect 0 still carried rapid-guess onset; harness showed dAUROC 0.025 / 8 of 20 passes at the fake null; fixed.
80%-CI L2 bar false-passes 16.7% (10/60) of 30-child null pilots.
Per-chunk R buffer reset misaligned R windows vs P; replaced by FIFO with join padding.
Worklet global stubs would leak across the single-process npm test; now restored in finally.

Verify pass: filler-detector eval re-run from the shipped ONNX on the same AMI/ICSI/FLEURS features reproduced every test, ICSI and FLEURS number exactly (word AUROC 0.9421 [0.9294, 0.9546], event P/R 0.7526/0.6012). Split re-checked: series-disjoint, speaker-disjoint asserted; threshold, Platt and epoch chosen on val only.

Capture-chain proxies on 4 AMI test channels (3 Indian-L1, 303 filler words; perturb_eval.py): word AUROC / event P,R: clean 0.932 / 0.895,0.644; AGC 0.933 / 0.882,0.597; spectral NS+15 dB noise 0.935 / 0.900,0.535; TV speaker at -10 dB 0.928 / 0.874,0.594; narrowband 300-3400 Hz alone 0.707 / 0.310,0.152; narrowband+AGC+NS 0.917 / 0.902,0.366. Fires in non-own stretches: clean 1.9/min, AGC 4.3/min, NS 0.3/min. Proxies, not phone recordings.

False LEADING filler >= 300 ms on fluent read utterances (FLEURS): hi_in 7.4% of 95, en_us 7.3% of 41; any false run in 27% of utterances (median 6-8 s). AMI test true-filler rate 6.67 per own-speech minute vs 3.4-3.8 false runs/min on read speech.

server/signals fillerLead counts haan/ji/ok/achha as planning fillers: readText('haan ji, paanch').fillerLead.v === true, so a deferential child's correct answer supplied Tier-T agreement for fragileCorrect. voicesig now uses register-aware rules.fillerLexOf(toks); signals fix proposed as A2b.

An absolute fillerLeadMs >= 300 ms E term fired every turn for a child who habitually opens with 'aaa', and on ~7% of fluent utterances by false alarm. Now the acoustic lead counts only at baselined z >= 1 (mature per-child baseline), and is ignored on bt / speaker_route.

Verify-pass guards in server/voicesig: (1) register-aware lexical filler; (2) acoustic filler lead only when unusual for this child; (3) detector ignored on narrowband mic routes; (4) voice-only licence only when g > 0; (5) safety abstain carries shadow:true, licence:null. Reverse (3) if a phone/BT-recorded child set shows narrowband recall >= 0.5; reverse (2) if pilot shows absolute lead predicts O1 better than z.
